ella (support): Customer on iOS app reporting sudden 401s for embedding requests since last week. Error from our API is `invalid_api_key`. They say request headers look fine on their side.
max (eng-infra): Thanks — do we have the client's raw request capture or proxy logs? any examples?
ella (support): Pasted the mobile SDK log they sent (redacted token):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer rk_xxx...TRUNCATED
Content-Type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
{chunked body}
```
ella (support): They also sent tcpdump from their device; appears the Authorization header is being split across TCP segments (long token + chunked body). Customer tested from desktop (no proxy) and it worked.
max (eng-infra): Hmm. We saw a few flaky reports where edge workers mishandle headers when `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` present and Authorization header is large (>3.5KB). Could be header reassembly bug in our edge parsing layer.
jordan (eng-runtime): I recall a bug in our edge parser where we assumed entire header line arrives in one buffer; if split, we only validated up to first segment and dropped remainder. Repro steps:
1) curl --raw with chunked body and a very long bearer token (generate with `head -c 5000 /dev/urandom | base64`).
2) proxy through our staging edge worker with the current parser.
Expected: 401 because token truncated -> `invalid_api_key`.
max (eng-infra): Reproduced locally, see log snippet from staging edge: `auth: received header length 3780, read 2048, remainder dropped` -> token truncated.
sre-ryan: ops-bot flagged a small spike in 401 rate from the mobile channel yesterday at 04:12 UTC. Linked session ids: s-64321, s-64322.
ops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-47 created (auto). Priority: P2. Tags: auth, edge-parser, mobile.
ella (support): Customer asked for a workaround while we fix it. Any suggestions we can give them safely?
jordan (eng-runtime): Short-term options: 1) rotate to a shorter scoped key (reduce token length) 2) switch client to send `Content-Length` instead of `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` (hard on some mobile stacks) 3) temporarily proxy directly to our origin (bypass edge worker) — needs ops approval.
max (eng-infra): Ops approval: bypassing edge for a single org is doable via routing rule; I'll coordinate but it's heavier.
ella (support): I'll offer the customer option 1 & 2 (shorter key + try non-chunked request) and ask if they can repro with `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" --data-binary @payload --header "Content-Length: <len>"`.
jordan (eng-runtime): For the actual fix: I'll update the edge parser to accumulate header fragments until CRLF seen, add unit tests for split-header cases, and deploy to staging today. Patch: ensure buffer grows dynamically and don't drop remainder when header spans buffers.
jordan (eng-runtime): PR drafted: fix/edge-header-reassembly. Plan: staging deploy + 30m smoke, then canary to prod (5% -> 50% -> 100%) if green.
max (eng-infra): I'll provision a bypass route for the affected org in case they need immediate relief. ETA 2 hours.
sre-ryan: Logging note: add metrics for "auth.header_reassembly_drops" so we can alert earlier.
ella (support): Customer update sent: offered key rotation + steps to try non-chunked request; asked permission to enable bypass route if they want immediate uptime. They replied yes, please enable.
max (eng-infra): Bypass enabled for org-id: org_9876. Confirming customer now reports successful requests (0 401s in last 5 mins). :white_check_mark:
ella (support): Great — telling customer to keep the rotated key active; we'll notify them before we fully roll out the fix.
jordan (eng-runtime): Will merge PR after two approvals and start canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. I'll post link to PR and deploy playbook here.
ella (support): Action items summary: 1) jordan patch + tests (owner: jordan) 2) max keep bypass active until canary done (owner: max) 3) ella confirm customer rotates key and close incident when prod rollouts complete (owner: ella).
sre-ryan: FYI we should check for other clients using very long tokens or custom proxies that may split headers; added a short scan task to backlog.
ella (support): Thanks team. Closing loop with customer now. :pray:
